NO-CHANGE RUN - stamp and as_at only. All six runbook section 1 queries re-run against portal 25735731 at 21:27-21:33 GMT, plus a portal-wide deal hs_lastmodifieddate sweep, a company hs_lastmodifieddate sweep, a direct new-business-win check and a live NDA read of the eight agreement-true partners.

DEAL SWEEP EMPTY FOR A THIRD CONSECUTIVE HOUR - conclusive set-change evidence. hs_lastmodifieddate > 20:25 returned ZERO rows, so no deal anywhere in portal 25735731 was created or modified between the 20:30 read and this one. Because a newly created record carries hs_lastmodifieddate at creation, an empty deal sweep is conclusive that no deal entered or left the partner-sourced set, and that no deal-company association changed, this hour. The last deal write anywhere in the portal remains 18:01:50, now about three and a half hours before this read, so the section 5 bulk-edit clause is clear on the deal side.

COMPANY SWEEP - THREE WRITES, ONE OF THEM A PARTNER, NONE MOVING A FIGURE. hs_lastmodifieddate > 20:00 returned three companies: inploi 101297659104 at 20:22:58 and Ahmedia 463651705079 at 20:18:38, neither company_type Partner and so outside every count; and Ashby 443193102575 at 21:12:27, which IS company_type Partner. Ashby was already in the 70-company partner set and already at Disqualified in the committed baseline, and it still reads company_type Partner, partner_stage Disqualified, partner_manager Joseph Williams, no agreement, no partner_status. So it neither entered nor left the set and moved no lifecycle, agreement or records-to-fix figure - not a section 5 set change. Noted because this is the second hour Ashby has been touched while sitting at Disqualified (18:18:36 last hour, 21:12:27 this hour); if a later write moves it out of Disqualified that IS a set change and gets its own hold. The 21:12:27 write is fifteen minutes before this read, which is longer than the bulk-edit clause's 'last few minutes', and in any case no figure this run would patch depends on Ashby, so there is nothing for a mid-write snapshot to corrupt.
